params.prompt: Edit this existing fighting-game pixel-art animation atlas. Preserve EXACT grid layout, exact pose order, exact number of drawings, all existing main blue character poses and animation timing. Keep his blue swept spiky head, narrow red eyelids and dark red lips, yellow sleeves/gloves and blue pants exactly the same. ONE REQUIRED CHANGE IN EVERY DRAWING: attach the small dark creature from the second reference to the FRONT OF THE LARGE BLUE ACTOR STOMACH. Its navy/black spiky head has two very large WHITE eyes with black pupils, a broad BLACK muzzle and tiny RED smile, with tiny yellow hands below. The creature is carried on/embedded into the blue torso at the lower stomach, well below the main face. It moves and rotates WITH the main torso in crouches, jumps, attacks and floor poses. Never floats separately, never becomes a third independent character, no separate floor-level small body. Do not enlarge or change the main blue head or add eyes to it. Leave room between his main red lips and the small white-eyed creature. Preserve every full limb, every foot and hand. Crisp stepped pixels, consistent limited colors and dark outlines, hard solid pure MAGENTA #ff00ff background, no grid lines, labels or extra effects. Each cell still has ONE connected complete main blue actor including his attached belly creature. No yellow partner appears. Keep generous margins and every drawing fully inside the sheet. First image is the exact atlas to edit; second image is the creature detail; third image shows its original placement on the main blue stomach. Exactly 32 drawings in FOUR columns EIGHT rows.
